source_receipts.promotion_fixture_boundary: 40 source-backed environment identities; 68 canonical Ability links; repository canonical ingestion and full field-level mechanic normalization are not claimed by that package alone

reconciliation_states.canonical_links_preserved: The promotion package already asserts an exact Environment->Ability relationship. ENV-14 preserves it unchanged and may project it as a canonical source-linked relationship; selection never grants the ability.
reconciliation_states.source_collection_present_not_canonicall: An exact environment-specific source collection exists, but the promotion package did not promote Environment->Ability links for that profile. ENV-14 records the source relationship without converting it into canonical link authority.
reconciliation_states.multi_environment_source_collection_not_: The source explicitly declares a collection applicable to multiple environments. It remains ability-system-owned and is not attached to every matching preset.
reconciliation_states.source_backed_overlay_context_seam: Chaos/Foam source members explicitly require Chaos/Foam context. OVL-SUP-CHAOS-FOAM supplies the environment context seam, while ability identities, costs and mechanics remain externally owned.

property_evaluation_seam.rule: Where an ability's own source explicitly names an environmental property or context, the ability system may evaluate that requirement against the derived Resolved Environment and its contribution trace. ENV-14 does not rewrite the ability mechanic or fabricate a new Environment->Ability link.

examples.case: source ability explicitly requires toxic gas or airborne hazard
examples.resolution: Ability system may evaluate the resolved atmosphere/hazard context; ENV does not grant the ability or alter its save/mechanics.

examples.case: source ability belongs to Swamp Perks
examples.resolution: Exact Swamps relationship remains source/canonical as applicable. A newly authored Floodplain does not inherit the Swamp tree merely because both can be wet.

examples.case: Chaos/Foam perk explicitly says in the Chaos or Foam
examples.resolution: OVL-SUP-CHAOS-FOAM can satisfy the context seam when active, but the perk remains separately acquired and ability-system-resolved.
